subject: Initiate: Mutual Success Plan for AveryTech — goals & timeline
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Cole <samantha.cole@averytech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initiate: Mutual Success Plan for AveryTech — goals & timeline

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for the time last week. Per our call, I wanted to kick off a short Mutual Success Plan (MSP) to align outcomes, milestones, and roles so we can get your evaluation and procurement moving in parallel. The goal here is to make decisioning predictable for both teams and remove blockers early.

High-level proposal (draft):
- Evaluation objective: validate Redwood inference at 1k concurrent tokens/sec across typical AveryTech prompts (search & summarization)
- Success criteria: 95th pctl latency < 450ms for 512-token calls; embedding similarity parity within 3% vs baseline
- Duration: 4 weeks (pilot), starting the week of Mar 9
- Key milestone checkpoints: week 1 (env + test data), week 2 (throughput tuning), week 3 (cost/perf report + regression checks), week 4 (exec demo + procurement handoff)

Would you confirm that these goals match your expectations? If so we’ll share a one-tab MSP draft (timeline + owners) and book a 30m kickoff to assign owners.

Attached: Avery_MUTUAL_SUCCESS_PLAN_v1.xlsx (workbook with timeline + owners) — early draft. Also dropping the HubSpot deal link for traceability: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/HL-3721

Proposed kickoff slots (PST):
- Tue Mar 10, 10:00–10:30
- Wed Mar 11, 14:00–14:30
- Thu Mar 12, 09:00–09:30

Who from your side should we include as the technical champion and procurement contact?

Thanks — excited to get rolling.

--
Rafael Mendes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0192

Attachment: Avery_MUTUAL_SUCCESS_PLAN_v1.xlsx (Excel, 42KB)
From: Samantha Cole <samantha.cole@averytech.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@averytech.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initiate: Mutual Success Plan for AveryTech — goals & timeline

Rafael —

Appreciate the clear framing. This looks close to what we discussed; a few quick notes from my side:

- Technical champion: Tom Reynolds (cc’d) — he’ll own validation and run the tests with his infra team.
- Procurement contact: procurement@averytech.com — Laura in procurement will need the cost workbook and a simple T&Cs summary.
- Timeline: we prefer starting Mar 16 instead of Mar 9 (team availability). Four-week pilot still sounds right.
- Extra success check: include a short end-to-end integration test (search -> generate) as part of week 3 deliverables.

We’ll take a look at the MSP draft and come back with owner names for each line item by Wed Mar 4. Kickoff slot preference: Wed Mar 11, 14:00 PST.

Thanks — excited to see the draft.

Best,
Samantha Cole
Head of Data Products | AveryTech
samantha.cole@averytech.com | (617) 555-8873

Thanks Samantha — great, we’ll shift the start to Mar 16. Confirming next steps: 

1) I attached an updated one-tab MSP with the Mar 16 start, tentative owners marked as TBD, and the week-by-week checkpoints. Please review and add owner names to the "Owner" column by EOD Wed Mar 4. (Attachment: Avery_MUTUAL_SUCCESS_PLAN_v1.xlsx — updated tab)
2) Kickoff scheduled: Wed Mar 11, 14:00–14:30 PST — invite to follow.
3) Marissa (cc’d) — I’d like you to lead onboarding coordination and the E2E integration test scope; Karthik will be SE for tuning and throughput work.
4) Procurement: we’ll share a short commercial worksheet and a redlined SOW template during week 4 to speed sign-off.

Links and artifacts:
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/HL-3721
- Draft MSP (Drive): https://drive.google.com/open?id=1AveryMapDraft

A note on attachments: I also added a short scoping PDF (avery-scoping-notes.pdf) with the specific prompts and dataset slices we recommended for the pilot.

If that looks good I’ll send the calendar invite and attach the workbook to the meeting.

Best,
Rafael
